rules: Resume facts govern employment and education.
Portfolio-only work is labeled as portfolio evidence and is not attributed to an employer.
Role-positioning copy is based on verified skills and project evidence and is not presented as an employer title.
Placeholder links and unsupported metrics are excluded.
Present-tense employment is reported as stated in the September 2025 resume and should be reconfirmed before time-sensitive use.

profile.headline: AI/ML Developer & Python Engineer
profile.positioning: Building AI-enabled and full-stack applications with Python, RAG, and modern web technologies.
profile.summary: Omkar Ganesh Mahabdi is a Pune-based software engineer and Python developer. His resume documents C++ desktop-audio engineering, a prior MERN full-stack internship, and projects spanning React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, and cloud storage. His portfolio also demonstrates a RAG-based AI chat application built with FastAPI, FAISS, SentenceTransformers, Llama, React, and Supabase.

experience.status_note: Current status after September 2025 has not been independently reconfirmed.
highlights: Developed a real-time desktop audio recorder with input-level visualization and support for default and raw capture modes through WASAPI.
Integrated audio-device change detection and loopback recording using IAudioClient3 and Core Audio APIs.

highlights: Developed a MERN-stack website supporting student registration, college prediction, and exam enrollment.
